claims: McDonald’s Hunter Sauce launched on March 31, 2026.
McDonald’s Hunter Sauce is a limited-time dipping sauce.
McDonald’s Hunter Sauce is part of the "KPop Demon Hunters" (HUNTR/X) adult meal.
McDonald’s Hunter Sauce is a sweet chili sauce.
McDonald’s Hunter Sauce features a blend of chili, garlic, and pepper.
McDonald’s Hunter Sauce has a sweet, tangy, and slightly spicy flavor profile with a bold garlic kick.
McDonald’s Hunter Sauce is featured in the HUNTR/X meal.
The HUNTR/X meal includes 10-piece Chicken McNuggets.
The HUNTR/X meal includes Ramyeon McShaker Fries.
The HUNTR/X meal includes a Demon Sauce.
Reviewers compare McDonald’s Hunter Sauce to a mix of McDonald's classic sweet-and-sour sauce and a mild chili-garlic sauce.
Reviewers compare McDonald’s Hunter Sauce to the 2021 BTS meal's sweet chili recipe.
McDonald’s Hunter Sauce is designed to be paired with McNuggets.
McDonald’s Hunter Sauce is part of a collaboration with the Netflix film "KPop Demon Hunters".
